calls: RESOLVED: Riyadh Fashion Week 2026 (Oct 15-20) postponed to 2027 per FACT Magazines (Oct 15). No local runway signal this season. Riyadh Season (Oct 21) and Dubai Fashion Week (Oct 22-26) remain the nearest attention windows; verify they proceed.

DATA: Cucinelli 9M 2026 EUR 1.12bn, +13.3% cc (Q3 EUR 374.2M, +13.5%). FY26 guide raised to +12%. Retail +19%, wholesale +4%. Americas +20%, Europe +7%, Asia +14% (China sharply up). Middle East: no figure, Q3 'solid' despite low season and weaker tourism. Logo-free luxury messaging confirmed.

CONFIRMED (Harrods/Trendalytics): leather jacket as key autumn investment (+28% leather bombers), worn over a suit; aubergine, mustard and emerald as jewel accents on black/navy/grey; velvet, cashmere, buttery leather; pleated and belted trousers, straight denim; tie returns; knitwear a top market mover (Cucinelli, Polo RL, Paul Smith).

NEW (campaigns, W Magazine): tone splits into cultural-icon casting (Moncler), British heritage-sport (Burberry), stark no-prop minimalism (Tom Ford, Ackermann), art-dialogue quiet (Loewe x Loro Piana). Gorpcore-meets-tailoring layering (tracksuit under overcoat, windbreaker as blazer) at Harrods.

PRICES (Harrods, GBP): Burberry cashmere-blend quarter-zip 855; Isaia cashmere polo 1,350, overshirt 2,825; Brioni blazer 5,880; Isaia blazer 6,290; Auralee alpaca cardigan 565; Stone Island rib sweatshirt 335.
SAUDI: openings of Missoni, Eleventy, Corneliani and Isaia in Saudi (Communicate Online, Aug 30); demand extending from weddings into daywear. No menswear-specific spend data found.
OPEN: Zegna Q3 (Oct 22), verify Riyadh Season/Dubai FW, follower recount (7th run without), Toby/ILLIYEEN verification. Band-collar bridge hypothesis untested.
